summary: Seven previously populated board calendars accounted for a 203-meeting shortfall. Presence and population are recorded separately so a successful empty response cannot pass as healthy.

sources.observation: Host returns HTTP 403 for empty or generic Mozilla/5.0 User-Agent strings and HTTP 200 for an identifying acquisition User-Agent; acquisition now sends cityscroll-community-board-acquisition/1.0.
Same host-family User-Agent refusal as Bronx CB6; identifying User-Agent restores a populated calendar page.
Same host-family User-Agent refusal on cbmanhattan.cityofnewyork.us; identifying User-Agent restores extractable events.
Same host-family User-Agent refusal on cbmanhattan.cityofnewyork.us; identifying User-Agent restores extractable events.
Publisher returned HTTP 200 with extractable Schema.org events, but the acquisition transport treated ordinary prose containing the word challenges as challenge_html and yielded zero records.

Calendar page answered HTTP 200 while the required Airtable shared-view child produced no extractable meetings; presence without population. Current iframe harvest yields meetings once the shared-view child completes.
Same host-family User-Agent refusal on cbmanhattan.cityofnewyork.us; identifying User-Agent restores extractable events.

council_outcomes.observation: Roll calls with person rows but missing or mismatched event_id and event_item_id are reduced to tally-only retention so they are never published as agenda-item-traceable votes.

invariants.presence: source responds with a non-error status
invariants.population: response yields at least one extractable meeting for the role
invariants.rule: A source that responds successfully while producing none fails population and must not pass on presence alone.
